stem: A dashboard shows the typical order value rising from €35 in Q1 to €58 in Q2. The query used the median for Q1 and the mean for Q2. Order values are right-skewed. What can you conclude about the rise?

options.text: Little: in skewed data the mean sits above the median, so the switch alone can explain it
Customers spent more in Q2, since both numbers describe the typical order
The rise is real, because the mean and the median of order values are usually about equal
Order values fell, because a mean is always lower than a median
